title: Google Confirms Gemini 3.5 Pro Isn't Ready Yet—Partner Testing Continues
summary: Google Confirms Gemini 3.5 Pro Isn't Ready Yet—Partner Testing Continues nokiapoweruser.com
body: Google Confirms Gemini 3.5 Pro Isn't Ready Yet—Partner Testing Continues nokiapoweruser.com
summaryZh: Google官方确认Gemini 3.5 Pro目前尚未准备就绪，当前正处于合作伙伴的持续测试阶段。该消息澄清了市场对该模型近期发布的猜测，表明其在正式面向公众推出前仍需经过严格验证。原始信息显示：Google Confirms Gemini 3.5 Pro Isn't Ready Yet—Partner Testing Continues nokiapoweruser.com。该消息由nokiapoweruser.com发布，主题为“Google Confirms Gemini 3.5 Pro Isn't Ready Yet—Partner Testing Continues”。其重要性主要体现在：Google确认Gemini 3.5 Pro尚未完全准备就绪，目前仍在合作伙伴测试阶段，对模型发布预期有直接指导意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
